title: Qwen3.6-27B XTX Q4T16 output-major shared-B LDS

change.description: Store the existing decoded 48-column x K256 shared-B slab output-major so each lane's K16 WMMA B fragment is contiguous in LDS.

actual_weight_micro_512.method: 21 counterbalanced synchronized-wall samples for the original single-wave owner versus the output-major shared-B owner

decision: Retain the output-major LDS specialization as the sole Q4T16 dense prefill owner. It preserves exact arithmetic and resources, improves the complete 512/128 prefill row by 1.579%, and leaves decode neutral. The frozen prefill and memory closure gates remain open.
